scope.panel: F3 metric-feature-scale Triplet-input-only intervention under normalized BN/CE and L2_1536 deployment
scope.formal_evaluations: six real_gt full-query/full-gallery strict reload evaluations
scope.local_execution: stdlib-only file reading, hashing, JSON parsing, AST parsing, counts, arithmetic and output writing
scope.runtime_scope: actual train/evaluate/scorer/report entry and callees plus storage-only finish/deploy/retirement provenance
scope.review_boundary: No cross-family assurance; no runtime model or tensor replay; no remote image reread.

A.title: Ground truth provenance
A.finding: All three full official protocols use dataset filename/metadata identities and environment labels. Train/test identities are disjoint; every query has a valid positive. RGBNT camera and MSVR scene exclusion removes same-identity/same-environment records only; the MSVR gallery retains 103 gallery-only identities (464 records). No model-generated GT path was found. Dataset image bytes were not reread.

B.title: Normalization and denominators
B.finding: The intervention L2-normalizes feature vectors; deployment normalizes the 1536-dimensional embedding and uses squared Euclidean distances. AP divides precision summed at true-positive ranks by valid GT positives, and CMC averages valid GT queries. No division of reported scores by model prediction statistics, score calibration, reranking or post-hoc gain rescaling was found. Pinned CLIP attention output feeds residual feature blocks, not any metric denominator.

C.title: Existence, fidelity and completion
C.finding: All 265 source and 126 primary-text bindings match. Six eight-step M0 receipts, 300 formal epochs, 20,416 formal steps and six strict evaluations are internally consistent. All reported row metrics, selected epochs, costs, norms, step counts, paired subtraction/gates and identity aggregates match their primary records or independently checked arithmetic. The largest strict selected-versus-reload metric error is 0.000001452251595424059 mAP points, below the unchanged 0.00001 tolerance. Completion is a documented composite of original full training plus one separately launched missing evaluation and one original CPU report; the original controller remains archived FAILED. Remote binary size/SHA receipts were checked, not replayed.

D.title: Executed paths and intervention
D.finding: The F3 main guard executes configure before foundation.main. It replaces foundation construction/loader/loss while retaining the original functions captured by the imported F2 module. F2 main-guard configure does not execute on import. Both F3 arms feed normalized features to BN/CE and return normalized deployment features; only the Triplet input switches normalized/raw, with no detach on the loss path. The actual Signal global path has USE_A/USE_B false and yields 3x512 features. Roles/adapters and inherited author-recipe branches are not claimed active. The report invokes CPU distance analysis after actual evaluator/scorer parity checks.

E.title: Scope, matching and causality
E.finding: Within each dataset the arms share seed42, initial state, trainable capacity, full protocol, optimizer/head/augmentation recipe, B64/K8, all50 epochs and exact logged label/camera/path batch-order bytes; prior F2 order bytes also match. Public initialization and all-trainable optimizer/gradient coverage are bound. The gate remains delta mAP >=0.5 and delta Rank-1 >=0: only MSVR310 passes. Official-set checkpoint and method selection, one seed, unarchived augmented pixels and fixed-model identity bootstrap limit generalization. F2 changed both CE and metric inputs, so cross-panel differences do not automatically identify isolated CE causality. Time includes training and epoch evaluation and is not controlled inference speed.

F.title: Evaluation classification
F.finding: All six formal full-query/full-gallery retrieval evaluations are real_gt. M0 reload/gradient checks and initialization-pair CE/deployment parity checks are engineering probes, not retrieval improvement evidence. Fixed-model identity diagnostics reuse real GT; they are not seed repetitions. No synthetic_proxy, self_supervised_proxy, simulation_only or human_eval result is used as the formal retrieval result.
